import copy
import unittest

from solution import summarize_activity


class SummarizeActivityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_earliest_latest_and_tie_stability(self):
        checkins = [
            {"asset": "first-tie", "location": "A", "timestamp": "2024-02-29 08:15"},
            {"asset": "later", "location": "B", "timestamp": "2024-03-01 00:00"},
            {"asset": "second-tie", "location": "C", "timestamp": "2024-02-29 08:15"},
        ]
        repairs = [
            {"asset": "first-latest", "location": "Y", "timestamp": "2025-12-31 23:59", "minutes": 0},
            {"asset": "older", "location": "X", "timestamp": "2020-01-01 10:00", "minutes": 12},
            {"asset": "second-latest", "location": "Z", "timestamp": "2025-12-31 23:59", "minutes": 9},
        ]
        checkins_original = copy.deepcopy(checkins)
        repairs_original = copy.deepcopy(repairs)

        result = summarize_activity(checkins, repairs)

        self.assertEqual(result, (
            "Asset first-tie checked in at A on 2024-02-29 08:15",
            "Asset first-latest repaired at Y on 2025-12-31 23:59 for 0 minutes",
        ))
        self.assertEqual(checkins, checkins_original)
        self.assertEqual(repairs, repairs_original)

    def test_empty_lists_independently_produce_none(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize_activity([], []), (None, None))
        self.assertEqual(
            summarize_activity(
                [{"asset": "a", "location": "L", "timestamp": "2000-01-01 00:00"}],
                [],
            ),
            ("Asset a checked in at L on 2000-01-01 00:00", None),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            summarize_activity(
                [],
                [{"asset": "a", "location": "L", "timestamp": "2000-01-01 00:00", "minutes": 1}],
            ),
            (None, "Asset a repaired at L on 2000-01-01 00:00 for 1 minutes"),
        )

    def test_rejects_invalid_argument_and_field_types(self):
        valid_checkin = {"asset": "a", "location": "L", "timestamp": "2024-01-01 00:00"}
        valid_repair = {**valid_checkin, "minutes": 1}
        calls = [
            ((), []),
            ([], ()),
            ([1], []),
            ([], [1]),
            ([{"asset": 1, "location": "L", "timestamp": "2024-01-01 00:00"}], []),
            ([], [{**valid_repair, "minutes": True}]),
            ([], [{**valid_repair, "minutes": 1.5}]),
            ([], [{**valid_repair, "minutes": -1}]),
            ([{"asset": "a", "location": "L"}], []),
            ([], [{"asset": "a", "location": "L", "timestamp": "2024-01-01 00:00"}]),
        ]
        for args in calls:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    summarize_activity(*args)

    def test_rejects_timestamps_not_exactly_valid(self):
        invalid_timestamps = [
            "2023-02-29 12:00",
            "2024-13-01 00:00",
            "2024-01-32 00:00",
            "2024-01-01 24:00",
            "2024-01-01 12:60",
            "2024-1-01 00:00",
            "2024-01-01T00:00",
            " 2024-01-01 00:00",
            "2024-01-01 00:00:00",
        ]
        for timestamp in invalid_timestamps:
            with self.subTest(timestamp=timestamp):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    summarize_activity(
                        [{"asset": "a", "location": "L", "timestamp": timestamp}],
                        [],
                    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
